one_liner.value: DealCloud provides a REST API with OAuth2, API key, and bearer token authentication.
one_liner.quote: DealCloud MCP uses OAuth to authenticate, letting AI assistants connect on behalf of an individual user.

gating_notes.value: OAuth flow uses standard .well-known discovery; no client ID/secret required for AI clients.
gating_notes.quote: AI clients connect using OAuth 2.0. DealCloud MCP publishes its OAuth configuration through standard `.well-known` discovery endpoints.
